paras: Application: Honda Civic Type R FK8 (2017-2021) and FL5 (2023+), Acura Integra Type S DE5 (2024+) – LHD Part Type: Fluid Lock PCV oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0424-FL

Radium catch cans separate oil and water condensation from crankcase gases before they reach the intake, preventing oil build-up in the intake, intercooler, throttle body and intake manifold. Cleaner inlet air raises effective octane and improves performance, lowers hydrocarbon emissions, and the closed system keeps oil vapour out of the cabin.
hl: Fluid Lock: Patented design prevents overfilling and holds collected fluid until emptied
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet/outlet, 4AN ORB drain
Dipstick: O-ring sealed dipstick for easy inspection
Firewall Mounting: Mounts to the RH firewall, no modifications
